title: Task Contract
description: The complete specification a director must provide before delegating any implementation task to an implementer. Vague scopes such as 'improve the feature' or 'fix the UI' are not valid task contracts.

objective.description: Why this task exists — the purpose of the work.

current_state.description: Observed state of the code/behavior before this task.

target_behavior.description: Precise description of the behavior after the task is done.

must_read_files.description: Files the implementer must read before changing anything.

editable_files.description: Files (or glob patterns) the implementer is allowed to modify or create.

forbidden_files.description: Files (or glob patterns) the implementer must not touch.

interfaces_to_preserve.description: Public functions, endpoints, CLI flags, schemas, or contracts that must remain unchanged.

input_format.description: Expected input shape for the changed behavior. Use 'n/a' when not applicable.

output_format.description: Expected output shape for the changed behavior. Use 'n/a' when not applicable.

error_handling.description: Error situations that must be handled, and how.

preservation_conditions.description: Existing behavior that must not regress.

completion_criteria.description: Objective, checkable conditions that define done.

test_commands.description: Exact commands the implementer must run and report results for.

manual_verification.description: Manual verification steps, when automated tests are insufficient. May be empty.

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must be completed and reviewed before this task starts.

conflict_domains.description: Resources this task touches, used for the parallel-execution conflict check. Any overlap with another in-flight task forces sequential execution.
